title: Knowledge Import V1 (what happened to one imported entry, and why)
$comment: DL-KB-02 acceptance A4. An import has three honest outcomes and the response has to name which one happened: CREATED (nothing with this source/version/content existed), DUPLICATE (the same bytes from the same source at the same version were already stored -- nothing was written), and VERSIONED (this source is already in the library at another version or digest; the new entry is kept beside it and `related_entries` names the siblings). `explanation` is required in every outcome: 'already there' without saying what matched is the kind of message that makes an operator re-import twice.
